_comment: Copy to agent_loop.config.json (gitignored) and delete what you are not changing.
Only the keys present here override; everything else inherits from
src/agent_loop/config.py, which carries the REASON for each default -- read it
before changing a budget. Unknown keys are a hard error, not a silent no-op.
Point at a different file with --config PATH or $AGENT_LOOP_CONFIG.
BUDGETS AND THINKING: on a reasoning model, chain-of-thought is spent from the
same budget as the answer. If you set think=true, raise max_tokens in the same
edit -- 48000 with thinking on returned 125,070 characters of reasoning and
EMPTY CONTENT, and later 207,078 characters on a five-part feature brief
This warning used to sit above a plan/test default of exactly 48000 -- the
number it was warning about. Both are now 96000. Size a budget by the ANSWER
SHAPE: plan and test re-emit a whole ticket set or a whole test file every
round, while developer emits ONE TOOL CALL per turn and keeps 48000 on
purpose, so that a fifteen-turn run stays bounded.
